answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a refundable stake bond: each agent locks scarce collateral that unlocks only as independent peers attest its honest work over many epochs. A clone fleet must fund a separate ferrous-weight bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. Real standing accrues slowly, hard to forge as carved quartz, and no clever sonnet of claims buys it in bulk.
